summary: Trusted Onboarding Engine schema (Issue #15), extending the 452 conversion staging tables. Creates append-only onboarding_artifacts (immutable source intake: hash, size, provider, report type, period/cutoff, provenance) and onboarding_stage_events (stage completions, advances, waivers, preflight approvals; advances/waivers/approvals must be human, waivers need a reason, approvals need the preflight hash). Adds onboarding_stage / write_locked / approved_preflight_sha256 to conversion_batches with a guard trigger: one step forward only, only with a human advance event, execute only with a human-approved preflight hash, write lock open only in execute. Lets staged rows reference an artifact (domain, locator, raw source), widens conversion_runs.run_kind, records control level and declared tolerance (a tolerance needs a reason). No rows change; existing batches (stage NULL) are untouched.

preflight.name: onboarding tables do not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('onboarding_artifacts','onboarding_stage_events')

preflight.name: conversion_batches has no onboarding columns yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'conversion_batches' AND column_name IN ('onboarding_stage','write_locked','approved_preflight_sha256')

expected_changes: Creates onboarding_artifacts (append-only via trg_onboarding_artifacts_append_only; SELECT/INSERT grants; UNIQUE(batch_id, sha256); sha256/bytes/record_ownership CHECKs).
Creates onboarding_stage_events (append-only; CHECKs: human-only advance/waiver/approval, advance target, waiver reason, approval hash).
Creates function onboarding_append_only() and function conversion_batches_onboarding_guard() + trigger trg_conversion_batches_onboarding_guard.
Adds conversion_batches.onboarding_stage (nullable), write_locked (default true), approved_preflight_sha256 + CHECKs onboarding_stage_check and write_lock_only_in_execute.
Adds conversion_staged_rows.artifact_id (FK), canonical_domain, source_locator, raw_source; relaxes source_file_id to nullable with CHECK conversion_staged_rows_has_source.
Replaces conversion_runs_run_kind_check to allow the stage run kinds.
Adds conversion_control_results.level, tolerance_cents (default 0), tolerance_reason + CHECK tolerance_declared.
